content.query:
resources
| where id == "{VMSS_01}" or id == "{VMSS_02}"
| extend vm_properties = case(type == "microsoft.compute/virtualmachinescalesets",properties.virtualMachineProfile,type == "microsoft.compute/virtualmachines",properties,properties)
| extend vmSize = case(type == "microsoft.compute/virtualmachinescalesets",sku.name,properties.hardwareProfile.vmSize)
| extend hardwareProfile = vm_properties.hardwareProfile
| extend securityProfile = vm_properties.securityProfile
| extend vmSizeProperties = hardwareProfile.vmSizeProperties
| extend diskControllerType = vm_properties.storageProfile.diskControllerType
| extend imageReference = vm_properties.storageProfile.imageReference
| extend securityType = vm_properties.securityProfile.securityType
//| extend Generation = vm_properties.extended.instanceView.hyperVGeneration
| extend osType = vm_properties.storageProfile.osDisk.osType
| project id, location,name,vmSize,vmSizeProperties,securityType,diskControllerType,imageReference,osType,zones
